newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - NZ's Countrywide increases CP programme.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - NZ's Countrywide increases CP programme.

text.p: Countrywide Corp Ltd, wholly-owned by Countrywide Banking Corp Ltd, said on Monday it has increased its Australian dollar commercial paper programme to A$750 million from A$500 million.

Countrywide Treasurer Paul Hale said in a statement Countrywide had been able to secure competitive pricing in the Australian dollar commercial paper market, facilitated by a strong credit rating for the programme.
The facility, rated A1 by Standard and Poor's Corp, is being arranged by Macquarie Bank. Countrywide Banking Corp is wholly owned by the Bank of Scotland Plc.
